digest.component_or_area: LLM runner & weekly CI jobs (external-integration, prompt-eval)
propositions: Weekly live-LLM jobs (external & eval-live) make billable API calls but have no retrievable record of token usage (input/output/cache tokens, request count).

Token usage is captured in-code at PydanticAIRunner.run but is dropped by both job execution paths: eval discards _usage, external pytest surfaces nothing, and log lines are suppressed by NullHandler.
A new opt-in REBAR_USAGE_LOG environment variable-controlled JSONL sink at the shared _usage seam in runner.py will record usage for both jobs with a single hook.
The usage_log module must provide record(usage, op) to append JSONL lines, summarize(path) to generate Markdown totals+per-op breakdown, and a CLI entry point for GitHub Actions job summaries.
Both workflows must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG, append summarize output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY with if: always(), and upload the JSONL artifact to preserve token usage records.
